implementation.name: openFPGA-DonkeyKong (Analogue Pocket, ericlewis)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 125 HDL source files (18 systemverilog, 26 verilog, 81 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this openFPGA core ships 18 MRA files of its own; 2 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 7 through MAME's own cloneof relation, giving 2 distinct machine_id rows. 9 did not resolve (absent-from-mame-0288: 9). license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING file at its root and no licence grant was found in the HDL headers read (src/fpga/apf/apf_top.v, src/fpga/apf/common.v, src/fpga/apf/io_bridge_peripheral.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 125 source files (18 systemverilog, 26 verilog, 81 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/ericlewis.DonkeyKong/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier ericlewis.DonkeyKong.
